 TULSA, Okla. — Medicare Open Enrollment has begun and LIFE Senior Services wants to make sure you are getting overage that works best for you.
 The organization is offering free Medicare assistance to help people compare plans and understand their options that could lead to them saving money.
 "You want to educate them and give them the choice to make the decision that's best for them," says Kathy Jones, Medicare Assistance Program Manager with LIFE Senior Services. "You lay out the plans that are available, you go through them, what might cover their medications and their costs best, and then let them make that decision. It's very important that they have that ability."
 Open enrollment for Medicare runs through December 7. If you'd like to take advanctage of LIFE Senior Services' free program, you can call them at 918-664-9000 to make an appointment.
 If you would like more information about the program, you can go to their website here .
